title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Downtime Credit for Equipment Breakdowns
content:
A Ridgeline Tool Rental renter whose rented equipment broke down may be offered a downtime credit as the remedy for the breakdown. The credit is booked against the renter's malfunction report and takes effect when the renter accepts it.

## Conditions of the credit

The downtime credit is fixed only after the agreement carries the ProBuild rental discount entry owed on its rental time.

The downtime credit is not worked out until the agreement carries the engine overtime charge owed for its hour meter reading at return.

Restated in the same terms: the amount of a downtime credit waits on the agreement showing the ProBuild rental discount entry owed on its rental time, and it waits on the agreement showing the engine overtime charge owed for its hour meter reading at return.

## Capability

`accept_downtime_credit_2dc14db7` is the renter's acceptance of the downtime credit offered for a breakdown of rented equipment, as the remedy on one Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement. One call books a single malfunction credit line, dated today, tied to the renter's malfunction report, and lowers the amount the renter owes on the agreement by exactly the credit accepted. The renter sees the credit as its own line on the agreement and a lower balance.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The Customer Care agent unlocks `accept_downtime_credit_2dc14db7` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept the credit.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_agreement_id` | The reference number of the rental agreement (one equipment item) the credit is booked on, as given to the renter by the Customer Care agent from the rental agreement lookup. | Id |
| `rental_request_id` | The reference number of the renter's malfunction report the credit settles, as given to the renter by the Customer Care agent from the rental request lookup. | Id |
| `credit_amount` | The credit accepted, in USD, exactly as the agent stated it. | A positive number with 2 decimal places and no currency sign; stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places. |

## Return

On success the receipt returns `status` "credited" when the credit line was booked; `rental_charge_id`, the reference of the new credit line; `rental_agreement_id`, the agreement it was booked on; `rental_request_id`, the malfunction report it settles; `amount`, the credit in USD with 2 decimal places; and `balance_due`, the amount now owed on the agreement in USD with 2 decimal places, negative when the agreement is overpaid.
